free_tier.stated: No free tier. SLICE 512 is USD 24.00 a year; SLICE 1024 is USD 3.50 a month and is not sold annually on this page.

retention.stated: The slice persists while the term is paid; the page states no deletion schedule.

egress.terms: Unmetered bandwidth on a 1000 Mbps port, in the vendor's wording 'Unmetered Dedicated KVM Slice Servers'.

interface_detail: KVM slice with unmetered transfer on a 1000 Mbps port.
tooling: Any SSH client; KVM, so its own kernel.
chaining: USD 24.00 a year buys 512 MB with unmetered transfer and a real IPv4: twice ceiling, but the cheapest unmetered machine found here.

limits.value: unmetered transfer at 1000 Mbps; the vendor states no volume cap, so port contention is the practical limit

binding_note: With no traffic quota, the only thing that degrades is throughput under contention on a shared 1000 Mbps port.

identity_cost.detail: Self-service order with an email account; the page read states no card hold and lists no payment methods.

reliability_note: Long-running provider with a block-storage product on the same account.
confidence_note: Both prices and the shape are quoted from the vendor's page read.

evidence.proved: quoted: 'SLICE 512 ... 512 MB Memory ... 10 GB SSD Storage ... $24.00 per year'
quoted: 'SLICE 1024 ... 1024 MB Memory ... 20 GB SSD Storage ... $3.50 per month'

notes: This refutes the framing that BuyVM has a sub-USD-1 monthly slice. The cheapest machine on the page is USD 24.00 a year, USD 2.00 a month, and it has half the RAM of the USD 9.95 SoftShellWeb container.

extras.price_arithmetic: USD 24.00 a year / 12 = USD 2.00 a month. Out of pocket at order: USD 24.00.
